issues.description: The problem statement requires the Lecture constructor to follow the attribute order from the UML diagram (which lists numberOfInscribedStudents first, then lectureName, numberOfLecturers, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfTutors). The provided solution implements a constructor with a different parameter order (lectureName first, then numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors). This mismatch between the specified constructor parameter order and the solution's constructor can confuse students and cause constructor-signature tests to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor parameter order consistent with the UML and the problem instructions. Either update the solution and template constructor signature to match the UML order (e.g. (int numberOfInscribedStudents, String lectureName, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfTutors)) or modify the problem statement to explicitly accept the constructor parameter order used in the template/solution. Ensure tests expect the chosen, consistent order.
